nodes.value: Deep quarry finished all four layers: 16x16 and 64 blocks deep.
Deep quarry paused because the selected tool has 10 durability left. Repair or replace it.
Deep quarry stopped. Check water/lava, coordinates, reach, permissions, and tools.

16x16 DEEP QUARRY TEMPLATE

This keeps the normal 16x16x16 safety limit. Four Mine Area components run one after another, making one 16x16 quarry that is 64 blocks deep. Each section uses Slice 3 and Safe Path On. It clears standing room, walks onto the lower floor, then removes the old support pillar before continuing.

BEFORE RUNNING
- Test in a safe world.
- Put a pickaxe, shovel, and axe in your hotbar.
- Change X and Z in every layer to the same 16x16 footprint.
- Change the Y values to begin at your quarry top.
- Set Slice from 1 to 8. Three is the safer default.
- Leave Safe Path On so it tries to walk around holes.

CURRENT EXAMPLE
- X: 100 through 115 = 16 blocks.
- Z: 100 through 115 = 16 blocks.
- Layer 1: Y80 through Y65.
- Layer 2: Y64 through Y49.
- Layer 3: Y48 through Y33.
- Layer 4: Y32 through Y17.

GO DEEPER
Copy the last Mine Area component. Start its From Y one block below the previous To Y, then set its To Y 15 blocks lower. Example next layer: From 100 16 100 and To 115 1 115. Connect the previous completed output to it. Repeat for as many layers as needed.

Water, lava, or no safe walking route follows failed. Low durability follows tool_low.
